First-Party Data

Kota Tech Job Market Insights

Our continuous involvement in the local tech ecosystem allows us to observe hiring trends closely. According to our exclusive 2025 placement data from Bhavya Computer Classes:

  • Demand for Tally with GST professionals in Kota's coaching and retail sectors has increased by 40% over the past year.

  • Local businesses are actively prioritizing candidates with dual competency in Advanced Excel and Basic Python automation.

  • Over 65% of government and semi-government contractual openings in the region now mandate the RSCIT certification as a baseline requirement.
